metadata.title: Simulation data for "Double Flares from Black Hole-Star Binary Encounters with Massive Black Holes"

metadata.description:
Three-body scattering simulations of stellar binaries (black hole + star, and star + star) encountering a massive black hole, integrated with the SpaceHub code including post-Newtonian terms (1PN, 2PN, 2.5PN). These files reproduce all figures of Kritos & Perna (2026) with the code at github.com/Kkritos/smbh-binary (version 1.0.0); python3 scripts/get_data.py all there downloads them into the expected folders.

  • smbh_bhstar_bundle.h5 (HDF5, ~10 GB): main BH–star campaign. One row per encounter (~1500 realizations per grid cell over SMBH mass, binary separation, eccentricity and v∞/vorb), with outcomes and, for micro-TDEs, the disruption-time phase space. Outer pericenter cut rp,max = max(10 rt, 8 rg).
  • delay_per_event.csv, delay_cellsummary.csv: double-flare delay per micro-TDE and per grid cell, derived from the bundle.
  • smbh_bhstar_bundle_750.h5 (~5 GB): first BH–star campaign (rp,max = 5 rt, 750 realizations per cell), used for a convergence comparison.
  • smbh_starstar_collisions_Newt_results.csv, smbh_starstar_collisions_PN_results.csv: star–star encounters (312k each, Newtonian and post-Newtonian) for the comparison with Yu & Lai (2024).
  • bss_hyperbolic_bh10_star1_i3.06878_full.txt.gz (~14 GB uncompressed): full SpaceHub trajectory of the representative micro-TDE encounter used for the debris movie and figure.
